name: shell-tray
description: A 40 x 20 x 10 mm box hollowed out to 2 mm walls, its top left open (face 5, the top in elements() order), like a tray. Worked out by hand: volume 8000 - 36 x 16 x 8 = 3392 mm^3; area: the outside's 2800 less the 36 x 16 opening (576), plus the inside walls 2 x (36 + 16) x 8 = 832 and the inside floor 576, so 3632 mm^2. Bounds stay 0 to 40, 0 to 20, 0 to 10.
